title: The descended finite open exchange retains its original unit transpose
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Let $h:U'\to U$, $j':U'\to X'$, $j:U\to X$ and $g:X'\to X$ form an open-immersion square [def-cbc-open-immersion-square]. Use ordinary unbounded constant-ring module derived categories and their exact inverse images [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Write $F=j_!$, $F'=j'_!$, $H=h^{-1}$, $G=g^{-1}$, $J=j^{-1}$ and $J'=j'{}^{-1}$. Let $\eta,\eta'$ be the units of the recorded open adjunctions [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero]. Let $c:J'G\xrightarrow{\sim}HJ$ be `mapDerivedCategorySquareIso(moduleSquareG)` and $e:GF\xrightarrow{\sim}F'H$ the recorded `singleBeta`, both from [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-base-change]. For every $K\in D_A(U)$,
$$J'(e_K^{-1})\circ\eta'_{HK}=c_{FK}^{-1}\circ H(\eta_K).$$
Thus exact descent preserves the prescribed original open-unit transpose of the inverse exchange.

proof.text: The sheaf inverse exchange is singleBetaInvApp. The inverse law of the ordinary open Hom equivalence gives its unit equation directly from its definition, without using inverse_unit_transpose.

The proved private lemmas squareQFac and unitQ compute the exact functor comparisons and localized adjunction unit on Q of a complex. The proved localizedMateQ carries an ordinary unit equation to this formula by cancellation of factorization isomorphisms and equality in each degree. localizedMate transports it to all derived objects by essential surjectivity and naturality. Apply it to the inverse exchange and the inverse moduleSquareG; normalization of the derived isomorphisms gives the result.

theorem openBaseChangeDerivedUnit {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {U' U X' X : Scheme.{u}}
    (gU : U' ⟶ U) (j' : U' ⟶ X') (j : U ⟶ X) (g : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : OpenImmersionSquare gU j' j g)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsOpenImmersion j']
    (K : DerivedCategory (Scheme.proEtaleRingModules U (CR U A))) :
    (AD j' (CR X' A) (CR U' A) (CC j' A)).unit.app ((PB A gU).obj K) ≫
      (PB A j').map
        ((StrictTower.singleBeta (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) gU j' j g sq.toCommSq.w
          (IsPullback.of_iso_pullback sq.toCommSq sq.isoPullback
            sq.hom_fst sq.hom_snd)).inv.app K) =
      (PB A gU).map ((AD j (CR X A) (CR U A) (CC j A)).unit.app K) ≫
        (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso
          (StrictTower.moduleSquareG (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) gU j' j g
            sq.toCommSq.w)).inv.app ((OE j (CR X A) (CR U A) (CC j A)).obj K)
